name: Camp
blurb: Your little camp at the edge of the meadow. Milo's favourite spot is by the fire.

name: Translators' Lodge
blurb: Where Lexora's Translators trade notes, tea and tall tales. Maren keeps the kettle on.
quiet: Maren is buried in paperwork. Try again in a bit.

name: Whisperwood
blurb: Old trees, soft moss and a cold, chattering stream. Gentle enough for new Translators, mostly.
quiet: Whisperwood is quiet for now. Milo yawns.
locked: Milo is far too hungry to go anywhere. Check on him at camp.

name: The Old Hollow
blurb: The oldest part of Whisperwood: deep shade, standing stones, and a quiet that listens back.
locked: Maren wants to see you at the Lodge first.

name: Ember Ridge
blurb: Where the Emberhogs are supposed to stay.

name: Saltglass Coast
blurb: The sea, and things that live in it.
